faqs.question: What is GitHub Badges Generator?
faqs.answer: GitHub Badges Generator is a free online tool that allows developers to create Shields.io style badges for GitHub README files, portfolios, and documentation.

faqs.question: What does this badge generator tool do?
faqs.answer: This tool generates GitHub badges in Markdown and HTML format so developers can easily add technology badges to their README files or websites.

faqs.question: Is the GitHub Badges Generator free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, this tool is 100% free and allows users to generate unlimited badge codes without any signup.

faqs.question: Can I generate multiple badges at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes, users can select multiple technologies and generate multiple badges together in a single output.

faqs.question: What output formats are supported?
faqs.answer: The generator supports both Markdown code for GitHub README files and HTML code for websites or blogs.

faqs.question: How many technology categories are available?
faqs.answer: The tool includes more than 40 categories covering programming languages, frameworks, tools, cloud services, and platforms.

faqs.question: Can I customize badge colors?
faqs.answer: Yes, users can customize badge colors and logo colors using HEX values to match their design.

faqs.question: Can I change the badge style?
faqs.answer: Yes, multiple badge styles are supported including for-the-badge, flat, flat-square, plastic, and social.

faqs.question: Does the tool provide a live preview?
faqs.answer: Yes, the tool provides a live preview so users can see how badges will look before copying the code.

faqs.question: Is there any limit on generating badges?
faqs.answer: No, users can generate unlimited badge codes. The tool includes most commonly used technologies.

faqs.question: Does the tool use Shields.io?
faqs.answer: The tool follows the Shields.io badge format which is widely used for GitHub badges.

faqs.question: Can I align badges in my README?
faqs.answer: Yes, the tool supports badge alignment options such as left, center, and right.

faqs.question: Can I change badge orientation?
faqs.answer: Yes, users can switch between horizontal and vertical badge orientation.

faqs.question: Do I need coding knowledge to use this tool?
faqs.answer: No, the tool is beginner friendly. Users simply select technologies and the generator automatically creates the code.
